- `defaultValue?: Single | Multi`
- `isDisabled?: boolean`
- `disabled?: boolean` — **deprecated** — Use isDisabled instead.
- `orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'`
- `isDetached?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `items?: ToolbarToggleShorthandItem[]` — Shorthand API: render toggle items from an array instead of the compound slot API
- `rovingFocus?: boolean` — Whether to use roving focus for keyboard navigation
- `dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'` — Text direction
- `loop?: boolean` — Whether keyboard navigation loops around
- `as?: string` — Render as a different element
- `asChild?: boolean` — Merge props onto child element
- `name?: string` — Form field name
- `isRequired?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean` — Whether a value is required — **deprecated** — Use isRequired instead.
- emits: `@update:modelValue`
- slots: `#default`

**ToolbarToggleItem**
- `value: string`
- `variant?: 'default' | 'ghost'` — default `default`
- `size?: 'lg' | 'md' | 'sm'` — default `md`
- `isIconOnly?: boolean`
- `isDisabled?: boolean`
- `disabled?: boolean` — **deprecated** — Use isDisabled instead.
- `class?: string`
- `as?: string` — Render as a different element
- `asChild?: boolean` — Merge props onto child element
- slots: `#default`

### Tooltip

**Tooltip**
- `defaultOpen?: boolean` — default `false`
- `open?: boolean`
- `delayDuration?: number`
- `disableHoverableContent?: boolean`
- `disableClosingTrigger?: boolean`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `ignoreNonKeyboardFocus?: boolean`
- emits: `@update:open`

**TooltipProvider**
- `delayDuration?: number` — default `700`
- `skipDelayDuration?: number` — default `300`
- `disableHoverableContent?: boolean` — default `false`
- `disableClosingTrigger?: boolean` — default `false`
- `isDisabled?: boolean`
- `disabled?: boolean` — **deprecated** — Use isDisabled instead.
- `ignoreNonKeyboardFocus?: boolean` — default `false`
- `content?: object`
- slots: `#default`

**TooltipTrigger**
- `asChild?: boolean`
- `as?: string | object`
- `class?: ClassValue`
- slots: `#default`

**TooltipContent**
- `side?: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'` — default `top`
- `sideOffset?: number` — default `8`
- `sideFlip?: boolean`
- `align?: 'start' | 'center' | 'end'` — default `center`
- `alignOffset?: number` — default `0`
- `alignFlip?: boolean`
- `avoidCollisions?: boolean` — default `true`
- `collisionBoundary?: Element | null | Array<Element | null>`
- `collisionPadding?: number | Partial<Record<'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left', number>>` — default `8`
- `arrowPadding?: number`
- `hideShiftedArrow?: boolean`
- `sticky?: 'partial' | 'always'`
- `hideWhenDetached?: boolean`
- `positionStrategy?: 'fixed' | 'absolute'`
- `updatePositionStrategy?: 'always' | 'optimized'`
- `disableUpdateOnLayoutShift?: boolean`
- `prioritizePosition?: boolean` — default `true`
- `class?: string`
- emits: `@escape-key-down`, `@pointer-down-outside`
- slots: `#default`

**TooltipArrow**
- `as?: string | object`
- `asChild?: boolean`
- `width?: number`
- `height?: number`
- `class?: string`

### Tree

**Tree**
- `items?: T[]` — default `() => []`
- `modelValue?: T | T[]`
- `defaultValue?: T | T[]`
- `expanded?: string[]`
- `defaultExpanded?: string[]` — default `() => []`
- `getKey: (item: T) => string`
- `getChildren?: (item: T) => T[] | undefined` — default `(item: T) => item.children as T[] | undefined`
- `multiple?: boolean` — default `false`
- `selectionBehavior?: 'toggle' | 'replace'` — default `toggle`
- `propagateSelect?: boolean` — default `false`
- `size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'` — default `md`
- `class?: ClassValue`
- `classNames?` — per-slot class overrides: root
- `dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'` — Text direction
- `isDisabled?: boolean` — Whether the entire tree is disabled
- `disabled?: boolean` — **deprecated** — Use isDisabled instead.
- `bubbleSelect?: boolean` — Whether selection bubbles up to parent nodes
- `as?: string` — Render as a different element
- `asChild?: boolean` — Merge props onto child element
- emits: `@update:modelValue`, `@update:expanded`
- slots: `#default`

**TreeItem**
- `value: T`
- `level: number`
- `class?: ClassValue`
- `classNames?` — per-slot class overrides: item, itemContent
- `as?: string` — Render as a different element
- `asChild?: boolean` — Merge props onto child element
- emits: `@select`, `@toggle`
- slots: `#default`

**TreeItemToggle**
- `isExpanded?: boolean` — default `false`
- `hasChildren?: boolean` — default `true`
- `class?: ClassValue`
- `classNames?` — per-slot class overrides: itemToggle
- slots: `#default`

### YearRangePicker

**YearRangePicker**
- `defaultValue?: DateRange | null`
- `defaultPlaceholder?: DateValue`
- `minValue?: DateValue`
- `maxValue?: DateValue`
- `isYearDisabled?: (date: DateValue) => boolean`
- `isYearUnavailable?: (date: DateValue) => boolean`
- `locale?: string`
- `yearsPerPage?: number` — default `12`
- `preventDeselect?: boolean` — default `false`
- `allowNonContiguousRanges?: boolean` — default `false`
- `maximumYears?: number`
- `isReadOnly?: boolean`
- `readonly?: boolean` — **deprecated** — Use isReadOnly instead.
- `isDisabled?: boolean`
- `disabled?: boolean` — **deprecated** — Use isDisabled instead.
- `calendarLabel?: string`
- `initialFocus?: boolean` — default `false` — Initial focus state.
- `dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl'` — Text direction.
- `nextPage?: (placeholder: DateValue) => DateValue` — Navigate to next page.
- `prevPage?: (placeholder: DateValue) => DateValue` — Navigate to previous page.
- `fixedDate?: 'start' | 'end'` — Fix one end of the range.
- `as?: string` — Render as a different element or component.
- `asChild?: boolean` — Render child as root element.
- `class?: ClassValue`
- `classNames?` — per-slot class overrides: base, header, navButton, navButtonIcon, heading, grid, gridBody, gridRow, cell
- `v-model: DateRange | null`
- `v-model:placeholder: DateValue | undefined`
- emits: `@update:start-value`
- slots: `#heading`
